title: Interpret Log Entries
prompt: Match each log entry to its most likely interpretation.

pairs.left: Repeated 4625 events across 8 accounts within 2 minutes
Successful login from two countries within 30 minutes
Timestamp modification on a system file
powershell.exe process with an encoded command string

explain: Context is key: multiple accounts with the same password = spraying; two incompatible locations = impossible travel; modified timestamps are an indicator of tampering.
